description: In front of you on the bed are a gray plastic tray holding ice cubes, a yellow cup, and a purple scoop off to the right. The left hand grasps the yellow cup, lifts it up and over the gray tray, tilts and rotates it downward to dump the ice into the tray, then turns it upright and lowers it back down, while the right hand stays mostly still near the purple scoop without touching anything.
